decision: D-001: Adopt the OVPR fix plan's three rules (a version bump is just a version bump; Directive's own changes pass the commit gate; every entry point fails the same way with the right instruction), proven by the no-agent fixture test, in five fixed phases (safety; upgrade and refresh defects; Rule 1; Rules 2 and 3 in full; small fixes, docs and close-outs).
